initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Multiple Items
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I am reaching out to request a detailed sales quote for a selection of items we are planning to purchase for our upcoming promotional event. Please see the list below, and let me know if you require any further information to process this request:

1. 10 units of WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (Item No: AITEM-0001) – We need these delivered by the end of next month, if possible.
2. 25 units of Soda - Medium (AITEM-0061), preferably in cans. If you offer different packaging options, please specify.
3. 15 T-Shirts – We are looking for a mix of sizes and colors, but at this stage, please quote for 'T-Shirt' as listed in your catalog. We will confirm specifics after seeing your options.
4. 5 units of SmartToys Fast Car Set (AITEM-0017).
5. 12 units of MagicToyland Fairy Doll (AITEM-0004).

If there are any minimum order requirements or lead times for these products, kindly include those details in your reply. Also, please advise if you offer bulk pricing or any relevant discounts for larger quantities.

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

I'm reaching out to get a quote for a few products for our upcoming event. I want to make sure I provide all the info you need, but please let me know if anything is unclear or if you need more details!

Here’s what I’d like pricing for:

- 10 WonderWagon Bicycles (Item No: AITEM-0011) – please include delivery options if possible.
- 25 T-Shirts – we’re looking for a mix of sizes, but I’m not sure which ones you have available. Can you quote for the standard T-Shirt? (I saw several listed, but didn’t see size or color details.)
- 5 Playlandia Colorful Play Mats (Item No: AITEM-0007)
- 20 Rasta Coffee Beans (Item No: AITEM-0026), ideally in 1kg bags if you offer them.

If you need more info on the T-Shirts or anything else, just let me know. We’d like delivery by the end of next month if possible.

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson

test_cases.name: Verbose, Impatient Multi-Item Quote Request with Ambiguous T-Shirt Line
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several items, including an ambiguous T-Shirt line missing variant details, while expressing impatience and frustration with previous delays.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Please Process ASAP
initial_turn.body:
I need a quote for the following items, and frankly, I expect this to be handled quickly this time. Last time, your team took forever to get back to me, so let's not repeat that. Here are the items:

- 10 units of JoySprout Toy Car Set (Item No: AITEM-0008). Please confirm if you have enough stock for immediate shipment.
- 25 units of Screwdriver (AITEM-0042), standard size, for our maintenance department. Make sure you include the bulk pricing.
- T-Shirt – I need a batch for our summer event, but your catalog lists several T-Shirts and it's not clear which is the regular one. Just quote me for 'T-Shirt' (no item number), size mix not specified yet, but I need to know the price per unit first. If you can't figure this out, let me know, but I don't have time to dig through your confusing catalog.
- 5 Mango (AITEM-0072), fresh, delivered by end of next week.

If you need more info, ask, but please don't waste my time with unnecessary questions. I expect a prompt reply.

Best regards,
Rasmus Delaney
